words.English Meaning: to think / to believe / to consider
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我认为多和母语者交流是学语言最好的方法。(Wǒ rènwéi duō hé mǔyǔzhě jiāoliú shì xué yǔyán zuì hǎo de fāngfǎ.) — I believe conversing more with native speakers is the best way to learn languages.
对于这个决定，没有人提出反对意见。(Duìyú zhè ge juédìng, méiyǒu rén tíchū fǎnduì yìjiàn.) — Regarding this decision, no one voiced any objection.
很多水果富含维生素，比如橙子和苹果。(Hěn duō shuǐguǒ fùhán wéishēngsù, bǐrú chéngzi hé píngguǒ.) — Many fruits are rich in vitamins, for example oranges and apples.
因为喜欢中国文化，所以我开始学中文。(Yīnwèi xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà, suǒyǐ wǒ kāishǐ xué Zhōngwén.) — Because I like Chinese culture, I began learning Chinese.
今天下大雨，所以我们留在家中看书。(Jīntiān xià dàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen liú zài jiā zhōng kànshū.) — It's raining heavily today, so we stayed home reading.
虽然学中文很难，但是很有趣。(Suīrán xué Zhōngwén hěn nán, dànshì hěn yǒuqù.) — Although learning Chinese is challenging, it is very interesting.
虽然工作很忙，但是他每天都坚持锻炼。(Suīrán gōngzuò hěn máng, dànshì tā měitiān dōu jiānchí duànliàn.) — Although work is busy, he still exercises daily.
如果明天天气晴朗，我们就去郊游。(Rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì qínglǎng, wǒmen jiù qù jiāoyóu.) — If tomorrow is sunny, we'll go for an outing.
只要坚持练习，你的发音就会越来越好。(Zhǐyào jiānchí liànxí, nǐ de fāyīn jiù huì yuèláiyuè hǎo.) — As long as you practice persistently, your pronunciation will improve.
只有努力学习，才能取得好成绩。(Zhǐyǒu nǔlì xuéxí, cái néng qǔdé hǎo chéngjì.) — Only by studying hard can one achieve good grades.
他不但是我的老师，而且是我的好朋友。(Tā búdàn shì wǒ de lǎoshī, érqiě shì wǒ de hǎo péngyou.) — He is not only my teacher, but also my good friend.
这件衣服不但质量好，而且价格便宜。(Zhè jiàn yīfu búdàn zhìliàng hǎo, érqiě jiàgé piányi.) — This clothing item is not only good quality, but also affordable.
我认为坐高铁比较舒适和准时。(Wǒ rènwéi zuò gāotiě bǐjiào shūshì hé zhǔnshí.) — I think taking high-speed rail is relatively comfortable and punctual.
今天外面的风特别大，多穿点衣服。(Jīntiān wàimiàn de fēng tèbié dà, duō chuān diǎn yīfu.) — The wind outside today is especially strong, dress warmly.
随着春天的到来，天气越来越暖和了。(Suízhe chūntiān de dàolái, tiānqì yuèláiyuè nuǎnhuo le.) — With the coming of spring, the weather is getting warmer and warmer.
有空一定来我家做客！(Yǒu kòng yídìng lái wǒ jiā zuòkè!) — When you're free you definitely must come visit my home!
明天可能会降温，出门记得带外套。(Míngtiān kěnéng huì jiàngwēn, chūmén jìde dài wàitào.) — It might cool down tomorrow, remember to bring a coat.
进入施工现场必须戴安全帽。(Jìnrù shīgōng xiànchǎng bìxū dài ānquánmào.) — Entering construction sites requires wearing a safety helmet.
遇到不懂的问题应该主动请教他人。(Yùdào bù dǒng de wèntí yīnggāi zhǔdòng qǐngjiào tārén.) — When encountering unfamiliar questions, one should consult others.
我们最后决定下个月去北京旅游。(Wǒmen zuìhòu juédìng xià gè yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu.) — We finally decided to travel to Beijing next month.

words.English Meaning: to happen / to occur / to take place
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 刚才这里发生了一起小车祸。(Gāngcái zhèlǐ fāshēng le yì qǐ xiǎo chēhuò.) — A minor car accident just happened here.
经过三轮面试，他终于拿到了录用结果。(Jīngguò sān lún miànshì, tā zhōngyú nádào le lùyòng jiéguǒ.) — After three rounds of interviews, he finally received the offer outcome.
良好的家庭氛围对孩子的成长有深远影响。(Liánghǎo de jiātíng fēnwéi duì háizi de chéngzhǎng yǒu shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.) — A healthy family atmosphere has a profound influence on children.
每个人都有权利选择自己喜欢的生活方式。(Měi gè rén dōu yǒu quánlì xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de shēnghuó fāngshì.) — Everyone has the right to choose their preferred lifestyle.
无论刮风下雨，他每天都坚持早起晨跑。(Wúlùn guāfēng xiàyǔ, tā měitiān dōu jiānchí zǎoqǐ chénpǎo.) — Regardless of wind or rain, he insists on getting up early to run.
